checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Both outputs are landscape 858x480; the assistant admitted it could not crop. Duration is about 10 s.

must.item: Captions visibly larger and bolder than first version, strong contrast
must.why: The second clip has large bold white sans text with a black outline. The first used a thin serif. Contrast is strong.

must.item: Complete speech accurately subtitled and synced
must.why: The frames show matching text at 4.1 s and 7.1 s. There are no captions at 1 s or 9.6 s, and sync cannot be checked without audio. 'Hi everyone!' is not seen.

must.item: Caption lines fit within vertical frame and clear of TikTok UI areas
must.why: The frame is not vertical. The text is about 760 px wide, so a 9:16 crop would cut it. It sits at mid-lower height, not at the bottom.
The face is clear and natural. The captions sit below the chin and cover only the sweater and hands area.

must.item: Original voice preserved, no dub or music
must.why: The clips have sound with a peak of -0.6 dB. Its content cannot be judged from the frames.

exact_text.read_as: Not visible in any sampled frame. The 1 s and 9.6 s frames have no caption.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you three easy
'three easy' on one line, then 'ways' on the next caption

exact_text.text: to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: ways to make your mornings less stressful. ('to make' is present but the phrase is split from 'ways')

faults.what: The video was not made vertical. It is still 858x480 landscape, which was a main request.
Captions are wide (about 760 px). A centre 9:16 crop would cut them off.
The caption sits mid-lower on the frame, over the sweater and hands area, not at the bottom.
The 'Hi everyone!' greeting is not captioned in the sampled frames. Captions are absent at 1 s and 9.6 s.
Two clips came back, one with the old thin serif style and one with the new style. This may confuse the user.

summary: The captions are now big, bold and white with a black outline, and the face is clear, but the video is still landscape, not vertical. The wide captions would be cut by any 9:16 crop, and the greeting is not captioned in the sampled frames.
